description: This file defines a MessageEnhancer class that provides functionality to enhance messages using AI, including context extraction from conversation history, and telemetry capture. It imports external modules for types, telemetry, prompts, and configuration management.

classes.name: MessageEnhancer
classes.description: A class providing static methods to enhance messages with AI, extract conversation history, and capture telemetry.

methods.name: enhanceMessage
methods.description: Enhances a message prompt using AI, optionally including conversation history for context.

methods.name: extractTaskHistory
methods.description: Extracts recent relevant conversation messages from ClineMessage array for context.

methods.name: captureTelemetry
methods.description: Captures telemetry data related to message enhancement, including whether task history was included.
